summary: The candidate passes. It fixes all four findings that got the earlier job rejected. The verifier's cited-document rule, 'Judge user-facing output as its audience would', 'personal data' in the harms list, 'Change nothing', and the reader's producer_model guidance are all back, and the new FRAME_ANCHORS test list pins each one. The contract size test is still an exact assert_eq!, now on 929 bytes. docs/system-facts.md is a listed deliverable. No budget rises: only the producer budget changes, falling from 1300 to 1200. The CHANGELOG gives before and after token counts that match the system-facts lines. For tests, fmt and clippy I relied on Athena's recorded CI results. I also ran the budgets suite (7 passed, including system_facts_budgets_match_computed and the headroom rows), the new anchor test and the contract pin test; all passed. Decision D168 lists the removed passages by file, and I checked its claims and docs/agent-reference.md against the code. Three issues are worth fixing later; none drops a rule with no home. First, four frames say 'every rule is stated here', but some rules live only in the brief or the output schema. Second, D168 does not name the cut 'unrequested changes' or the change-capability verifier's 'an instruction a reader would follow must work here'. Third, D168 says the producer's no-cd/no-pipes limits restate the brief, but they are actually enforced by the policy hook.
